notes:
Controller remaps now take effect in PPSSPP and the AetherSX2 PS2 core.

If you remapped a control on a game's Controllers screen and it looked right but did
nothing once the game started, this is why. Standalone PPSSPP and the AetherSX2 core
are set up entirely by the controller mapping the launcher hands them at launch, and
that mapping was being built from your original controller setup rather than from your
remap. Every other system already applied remaps correctly, which is why only those two
were affected.

Your existing remaps work now with no changes needed. If you cleared a control, it now
stays cleared instead of quietly falling back to its original button. Nothing else
about your controls changes.
